name: serpapi_search
description: Structured shopping and search lookup via SerpApi across engines like amazon, amazon_product, google, google_shopping, and news. Best tool for Amazon product search, ASIN lookup, bestseller/listing checks, prices, ratings, reviews, product comparisons, and finding products to buy when the user asks about Amazon items or shopping results. Recommended shopping pattern: use engine=amazon first to gather and compare multiple candidate listings, then use engine=amazon_product with a chosen ASIN when you want one focused product page with richer details, direct link, image/thumbnail, and a cleaner final recommendation. If saving that focused product to Canvas, preserve the thumbnail by passing it to the canvas tool as image_url.

engine.description: SerpApi engine. Use amazon for Amazon listing/product searches, amazon_product for a specific Amazon ASIN/product page, google_shopping for shopping comparisons, google for general web search, bing, or youtube.

query.description: Search text. For amazon this is the Amazon product/listing query (maps to 'k'); for most others it maps to 'q'. Good for product names, shopping phrases, bestseller/category searches, and buyer-intent queries like 'best weather station under 300'.

asin.description: Amazon ASIN for a specific product detail lookup. Best with engine=amazon_product when you want one exact listing.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon domain for amazon engines (default: amazon.com). Example: amazon.co.uk

language.description: Locale for engines that support it (default: en_US).

device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

num_results.description: How many normalized results to return (1-10, default: 5).

sort_by.description: Optional sort mode. For amazon, friendly values like review_score, rating, reviews, best_reviews, price_low, price_high, newest, and bestseller are mapped to Amazon's documented sort parameter.

node.description: Optional Amazon category node filter. Useful when the query should stay inside a category like electronics or smart home.

rh.description: Optional raw Amazon rh filter string for advanced narrowing (for example category/attribute filters discovered from Amazon URLs).

min_price.description: Optional generic minimum price passthrough for engines that support it directly. For Amazon, keep the price range in the query and use rh when known.

max_price.description: Optional generic maximum price passthrough for engines that support it directly. For Amazon, keep the price range in the query and use rh when known.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

optimize_query.description: For engine=amazon, refine conversational input into a compact search query before first request (default: true).

extra_params.description: Additional engine-specific query parameters passed through to SerpApi.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw (large).
